title: Verify emergency information
label: VERIFICATION & PRIVACY
deck: Check the source, time, exact location and evidence before acting on or sharing an emergency message. Compare independent sources when possible. A forwarded screenshot, logo or urgent voice note is not verification. Act on obvious immediate danger without waiting for a post to be confirmed.
tldr: Check the source, time, exact location and evidence before acting on or sharing an emergency message. Compare independent sources when possible. A forwarded screenshot, logo or urgent voice note is not verification. Act on obvious immediate danger without waiting for a post to be confirmed.
steps: Find the actual organisation or person through an independently known channel. A familiar-looking account or copied badge can be fake.
Confirm the affected street, region and date. Old footage and information from another country can appear current when forwarded.
Use radio, direct trusted observations and verified humanitarian or official sources as appropriate. Several reposts of the same claim are not independent confirmation.
Write what is confirmed and what remains uncertain. Do not treat a claimed ceasefire, route, water safety notice or aid offer as certain without recent verification.
Forward only necessary verified information with its time and source. Protect live locations and personal information. Correct earlier messages if they prove wrong.
next: Keep a short list of known sources saved offline, including non-government humanitarian sources. Choose information based on reliability and relevance, not simply whether it is official or unofficial.
watch: Verification should not delay escape from visible fire, rising water or another immediate hazard. No source can guarantee that conditions remain unchanged.
without_help: If connectivity fails, use the observations you can obtain safely and your written plans. Do not travel into danger to confirm a rumour or follow a single anonymous message.
household: Assign a trusted adult to each person who needs assistance. Keep medicines, essential contacts and a workable reunion plan with the group. Make decisions around the least mobile person, not the fastest; avoid splitting the family without a clear, safe way to reconnect.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, safe drinking water, a battery light, footwear, phone power and written contacts accessible. Carry only what you can manage; collecting supplies must not delay escape.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
